items.difficulty_reason: For a prime p and a scheme S over F_p, the lemma asserts that the rule F(X) = lim_F Gamma(X, O_X) on the big h site (Sch/S)_h defines a sheaf (statement lines 11930-11939). The proof checks conditions (1), (2), (3) and (4) of Lemma labelled lemma-refine-check-h: condition (1) holds because limits of sheaves are sheaves and O is a Zariski sheaf, and condition (2) because O is an fppf sheaf by Descent, Lemma labelled descent-lemma-sheaf-condition-holds and because lim_F of an equalizer of F_p-algebras is the equalizer of the limits (proof lines 11941-11949). Condition (3) is turned into the bijectivity of lim_F A -> lim_F A/(fA cap J): the right hand side is identified with the fibre product of the two limits, and since J is annihilated by a power of f the ideal a = fA cap J is nilpotent, so lim_F A -> lim_F A/a is bijective (proof lines 11951-11967). Condition (4) follows from Lemma labelled lemma-funny-blow-up together with the E = P^1_Z identification, as in the previous paragraph (proof lines 11969-11983). Reducing condition (3) to the nilpotence of fA cap J and the bijectivity of the limit along a nilpotent quotient is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
